data.name: Siddharth
data.long_meaning: One who has accomplished all his desires, one who has attained perfection and enlightenment, derived from 'sidh' (accomplished) and 'arth' (goal).
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the pursuit and achievement of spiritual goals and the attainment of enlightenment.

in_sanskrit.name: सिद्धार्थ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has crossed all worldly desires and has attained spiritual enlightenment. It is the name of Gautama Buddha, before he attained enlightenment, when he was a prince. It is also the name of the protagonist in the Indian epic 'Mahabharata'.

in_hindi.name: सिद्धार्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: विदेशीय चौपाने के नाम से उत्पन्न हुए और साधनों के साथ-साथ सिद्ध होने वाले को. यह बुद्ध के पुराने नाम हैं जो उन्हें साधनों से मुक्त होकर सिद्ध हुए थे।

in_tamil.name: சித்தார்த்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Successfully accomplished or reached the goal. It is a Tamil name derived from Sanskrit 'सिद्धार्थ'.

in_telugu.name: శిద్ధార్థ
in_telugu.long_meaning: A person who has achieved the goal or enlightenment. It is a Telugu name derived from Sanskrit 'सिद्धार्थ'.

in_marathi.name: Siddharth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Achiever of Goals
in_marathi.long_meaning: Siddharth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has accomplished all his desires, one who has attained perfection and enlightenment, derived from 'sidh' (accomplished) and 'arth' (goal).

in_bengali.name: Siddharth
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Achiever of Goals
in_bengali.long_meaning: Siddharth একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has accomplished all his desires, one who has attained perfection and enlightenment, derived from 'sidh' (accomplished) and 'arth' (goal).

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Siddharth' appears in various Hindu scriptures and mythologies, most notably in the life story of Gautama Buddha.

data.cultural_impact: The name Siddharth holds significant cultural value in Indian history as it was the birth name of Gautama Buddha, the founder of Buddhism. Siddharth Gautama, who attained enlightenment under the Bodhi tree, renounced normal life and dedicated himself to helping others find spiritual peace. This name represents the idea of self-improvement and personal growth, which continues to be cherished and celebrated in Hindu and Buddhist traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: Siddharth is also a powerful spiritual name, symbolizing the ultimate accomplishment of personal growth and self-realization. In Hindu traditions, it is believed that those who bear the name Sidharth are blessed with wisdom, knowledge, and enlightenment. The name is associated with the attainment of moksha or liberation from the cycle of birth and death. Thus, Siddharth is a name that resonates deeply with the spiritual aspirations and longings of both Hindus and Buddhists.

historical_references.reference: Siddharth Gautama was a prince in the Shakya clan who renounced his royal life and became a wandering ascetic. He attained enlightenment under a Bodhi tree and became known as the Buddha.

trends: used as a given name for boys
modern_usage.modern_context: Siddharth is a common name for boys in various parts of the world, particularly in countries with large Hindu and Buddhist populations. It is derived from the name of the historical figure Siddhartha Gautama, who is revered as the founder of Buddhism.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Krishna Siddharth in Hyderabad, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Siddharth, which means "Achiever of Goals". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Siddharth signifies one who has achieved ultimate knowledge and spiritual enlightenment. It is a name deeply rooted in the spiritual journey, symbolizing the pursuit and attainment of inner peace and wisdom. The name embodies the essence of self-realization and the attainment of one's true potential.
